title: Grokking Circuit Robustness to Training Data Order

original_idea.body:
# Grokking Circuit Robustness to Training Data Order

**Problem:** Whether the modular-addition grokking circuit reliably forms under different data orderings or weight inits is rarely varied.

**Direction:** Train the standard tiny one-layer transformer on modular addition under several seeds and data shufflings. Run Fourier-component analysis and measure how consistent the learned frequencies are across runs.

**Why it matters:** Mech-interp's hope rests on circuit universality; a controlled test of whether even the cleanest known circuit is seed-robust is foundational.

**Relevant context:** Nanda et al. 'Progress Measures for Grokking'.
